currentRoundInspection.method: Two linked pictures visually inspected; standard viewer PMTiles/terrain control approximate fit. No bespoke survey/history source research.
observations: Steep oval hill with stone-faced slopes, irregular upper curtain and rectangular bastions; many low roofless rooms remain open.

Narrow ascending entrance crosses tall masonry arches between a smaller lower crenellated tower and a broad upper gate/throne hall. Gate facade has central pointed portal, projecting corbels, sparse windows and selective dark stone banding.
Upper gate roof is muted red with a small central raised polygonal lantern/roof. Large mosque carries a tall square minaret; the smaller mosque has a dome and slender faceted minaret.
Central open-air theatre has low stepped seating; roofed north range and small ancillary masses are retained, without inventing a complete medieval palace.
